title: Umudugudu uri ku nkengera y'ikigeragezo
intro: Uca wisanga uri mu gisagara co ku nkengera y’ikiyaga, aho ijwi ry’imipfunda rivanga n’ugusemerera kw’abantu bibagiwe. Baciye bahabwa itegeko ryo kuruhuka, ariko ukunzi kwabo kwatumye bahabwa igihano n’ubu kivugwa mu majwi acereje. Woba ushobora guhishura abo bari?
clues: Twaba ku nkombe kandi twahawe itegeko ryo gukurikiza umusi wo kuruhuka.
Uwo musi, amafi yaraza iwacu ari menshi cane, ariko twari twabujijwe kuyatwara.
Bamwe muri twebwe baragabishije ku bijanye n’ugucumura, ariko abandi baragira umugambi wo kuroba uko biri kwose.
Twararenganye itegeko ryeranda maze twizanira igihano gikomeye.
Igihano cacu cari uguhinduka kwadusigaye twacitse intege kandi twamaramaye.
Twarahindutse inkende, ikimenyetso ku bazoza inyuma bose.
arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
